fields.description: Issue features an investigative report alleging abuse by a Miami physician described as a "Torture Doctor" and related claims involving patients and associates. Editorials address anti-communist publicity and local politics, including Miami City Commission actions on annexation proposals for Biscayne Key and Virginia Key and commentary on city governance. Additional coverage includes Dade County Fair operations and concerns about children and gambling, Miami municipal court items, public health enforcement regarding watered milk, safety concerns about broken fluorescent lights, discussion of relocating/removing the F.E.C. station and tracks from downtown Miami, and printed legal notices and local entertainment advertising.
